summary: Prudential plc filed Form 6-K announcing new shares to be issued under its scrip dividend alternative for the 2025 second interim dividend of 18.89 US cents per share. The issuance of 5,721,904 ordinary shares is a routine capital maintenance transaction, not a special situation. The board intends to neutralize any minor dilution via on-market buybacks. No merger, acquisition, restructuring, or activist activity is present.
